description_expanded:
Hobnob | 158 Seagrove Village Drive

158 Seagrove Village Drive, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

Hobnob is a Seagrove Beach home that is located near Seaside Town Center and the white sandy beaches of 30A. This vacation rental home offers 5 bedrooms, 3 full and 2 half bathrooms, multiple living spaces, and a private pool. The 6 seat golf cart/LSV makes it a breeze accessing the beach or adventuring to Seaside for dinner and shopping!

The first floor of this home features the the living, dining, and kitchen areas, as well as an additional den where you could cozy up and read a book. There are four bedrooms located on the first floor. The first guest room has a king sized bed and an ensuite bathroom with a tub/shower combo. There are also two queen bedrooms and the fourth bedroom has a set of twin over twin bunk beds. These three guest rooms share a hall bathroom that has a shower only. As you venture out to the pool area, you will pass through the laundry room, which also has a half bath.

The second floor treats you to the master bedroom which has a private bathroom with a walk-in shower and soaking tub. A bonus feature in the master closet, is a second washer/dryer set. Your family will enjoy the large, den area that is located on the second floor. It has a TV, sofa and comfy chairs, a dining table which seats 6, and a kitchenette which has a full sized refrigerator, microwave, sink, and dishwasher.

The outdoor area features a 9x19 swimming pool as well as seating and a gas grill. You will have use of the garage for parking and a 6 seat golf cart/LSV.

This sweet beach cottage provides you with top of the line amenities for a memorable vacation, and a location that cannot be beat!

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum Age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 Cancellation Fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM.

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
